title: Primary Logo Clearspace
slide_intent: Keep other content away from the mark so its burger silhouette and name remain easy to distinguish.
strategic_value: A repeatable buffer can preserve the primary logo’s recognition across crowded applications.
demonstration: The primary logo sits inside a shaded clearance diagram measured with copies of its U; explanatory text sits at left.
practical_value: Use the width of the Burger U as the minimum separation from neighboring visual and verbal elements.

content_islands.name: Clearspace definition
content_islands.spec: Place the definition at upper left, identifying the width of the Burger U as the unit.

content_islands.name: Measured logo
content_islands.spec: Place the full-color logo to the right with a shaded perimeter and rotated U specimens on all four sides.

reference_purposes.Application: The paragraph and diagram define the minimum clearspace using the width of the Burger U.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Other visual and verbal elements must remain outside the defined minimum clearspace.

ingredient.name: Primary logo clearspace
ingredient.role: Keep the logo visually separate from adjacent content.
ingredient.application: Reserve at least one Burger U width around the logo.
ingredient.scope: Historical 2020 partner guide; applies to the primary logo, not the separate wordmark or Chinese lockup measurements.
